Sentence (English): The 636 recommended by a colleague, although the style is an old one, is said to have practical functions.
Comments (English): The 636 recommended by a colleague, although the style is an old one, is said to have practical functions. Considering that it is for general daily cleaning, the commonly used functions are enough. There is no need to pursue new models, and the price without a panel is more affordable. In order to match the color of the cabinets, I chose a machine without a panel, which saves money and looks good~~ The worst thing is that the logistics directly put the goods at the door without good negotiation, and called many times to argue, because I was afraid that I would not be able to move it. It was very damaging to the machine, but in the end I moved into the house by myself. The installer's skills are very good.

Sentence (English): We have been pleased with our Bosch 500 Series dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Great Dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || We have been pleased with our Bosch 500 Series dishwasher. It cleans very well (we are still getting used to not hand washing everything before putting it in). As an experiment, we have put casserole dishes in with minimal rinsing, and they come out totally clean. We love the 3rd (top) rack and the Auto-Air feature which pops the machine open at the end of the cycle. It leaves plastic stuff is a bit damp, but we decided we can live with that given the other excellent features. I looked at the higher end models with the CrystalDry technology, but that didn't seem worth the extra cost and several reviewers said it is expensive to service if there are any troubles. I installed this machine myself, was not too hard to do. As advertised, it is very quiet. We used to have to set our old dishwasher to run at night when we were asleep, but now we can run a load of dishes while we have guests in our adjacent open living room.

Sentence (English): I can't complain about how well it washes dishes, best of any brand we've owned.
Comments (English): [ Washes Well But Missing Some Basic Features ] || ---------------- || I can't complain about how well it washes dishes, best of any brand we've owned. But, for the price we paid, you'd think there would be a few features that even the lesser quality dishwashers seem to come with. First, a self-cleaning function would be nice. I toss a cleaning tab in and run a heavy wash, and I suppose that does the trick, but I have to wonder if a genuine self-cleaning feature would do more. Second, while the "Crystal Dry" function seems to help a little, and I mean very little, why not have the door pop open a few inches at the end of a cycle so that air can circulate and assist with drying? Most other new products do this. Third, put a digital display on the front that shows the remaining time in a cycle. I get that Bosch is wedded to the app which provides this information, but I'm not wedded to my cell phone, nor do I think one should even be required to download an app to know how much time remains in a cycle.

Sentence (English): Great dishwasher except for the undersized soap container.
Comments (English): [ Outstanding except for a couple of things ] || ---------------- || Great dishwasher except for the undersized soap container. The Kirkland pods we use sometimes keep the soap door from opening completely, so there is still detergent on the door and the dishes, necessitating an additional rinse cycle. We have found that we have too insert the pods in a special orientation in order to eliminate the problem. Also, we find that the “hump” running lengthwise along the two side slots of the middle tray are way too high, thus preventing placing some items, like bowls which collect and hold water because they are tipped to far back. We do appreciate the quietness, but we're surprised at how long the cycles take. But everything comes out super clean.

Comments (English): [ Washes Well But Missing Some Basic Features ] || ---------------- || I can't complain about how well it washes dishes, best of any brand we've owned. But, for the price we paid, you'd think there would be a few features that even the lesser quality dishwashers seem to come with.First, a self-cleaning function would be nice. I toss a cleaning tab in and run a heavy wash, and I suppose that does the trick, but I have to wonder if a genuine self-cleaning feature would do more.Second, while the "Crystal Dry" function seems to help a little, and I mean very little, why not have the door pop open a few inches at the end of a cycle so that air can circulate and assist with drying? Most other new products do this.Third, put a digital display on the front that shows the remaining time in a cycle. I get that Bosch is wedded to the app which provides this information, but I'm not wedded to my cell phone, nor do I think one should even be required to download an app to know how much time remains in a cycle.

Sentence (English): Louder than my previous Bosch 500 I had for 12 years.
Comments (English): [ Not as good as my previous Bosch 500 ] || ---------------- || Louder than my previous Bosch 500 I had for 12 years. Door is soft as I found out the pocket vs the handle model is not stainless steel but stainless look. The handle model door is stainless steel so much firmer and not flimsy. Wish I knew this before buying. The unit is loud despite being 44 dcb like my previous unit which was Bosch 500 44 dcb as well. I have no idea why you need a red light to shine on the floor except when the unit is drying as then it's quiet (no matter which cycle u run). Now I have to have a Bosch repair man come but if he does not find anything “wrong” even if dishwasher is noisier, I will likely have to pay for the service call. Maybe since these are newer models (only out since August 2023), there are kinks to work out. I do like the Home Connect feature as I forget to set my dishwasher often, but it is unreliable and often you cannot connect (I have an email complaint sent to Home Connect as this is the only way to reach them) and waiting on a reply as it's not Bosch in charge of the home Connect). Lastly, since I could not connect at all last night, I went to manually start the dishwasher and the electric panel went crazy and was just flashing off and on continuously (as well as the red floor light) and no matter what, I could not get it to stop so I could not run my dishwasher. The reply from Bosch was to turn my breaker off and on as the dishwasher was “confused” due to Home Connect. May I add that going to my unfinished basement to reset my breaker with a serious back injury that makes it hard to go up and down the stairs, is very inconvenient. All I can say is maybe I got a lemon considering the first Bosch delivered in July 2023 (the older milder of this Bosch 500) had a defective leg and had to be returned. Too bad as my previous Bosch 500 was a gem and only had to be replaced as I fell over the door when it was open which is ironically how I injured my back severely (PSA….always close the door before moving away from the dishwasher for ANY reason like letting your dog out in the backyard)!

Sentence (English): The kitchen is equipped only with Bosch appliances.
Comments (English): [ Disappointment ] || ---------------- || The kitchen is equipped only with Bosch appliances. I bought them two years ago and then I thought I was making a very good choice, just like that. 7 days before the expiration of the 2-year warranty, the error E 3100 appeared on my dishwasher. I called the service, he came on December 6, 2023, repaired the machine, left. Surprise! on December 31 (sic) while washing dishes, the machine started beeping. Again error E 3100. On December 31st. On New Year's night. Not even a month had passed since my car was repaired (sic, again) also for the E 3100. I called the service, but what do you see? the car is no longer under warranty, even though at the time of purchase I was told that it had a 5-year warranty, I registered it on electrocasnice-bosch, but I did not find any instructions on the website to request the extended warranty. This detail was missing. Finally, I am waiting to be contacted by another service to determine when they will come to fix my car. I hope that this time, the repair will last more than a month. I won't tell you anymore about the microwave oven that had an error near the end of the warranty. Ha!
Comments (Original): [ Dezamagire ] || ---------------- || Bucatariac este utilata doar cu aparatura electrocasnica Bosch. Le-am achizitionat acum doi ani si atunci am crezut ca fac o alegere foarte buna, doar ca. cu 7 zile inainte de expirarea garantiei de 2 ani, mi-a aparut la masina de spalat vase eroarea E 3100. Am chemat service-ul, a venit pe 6 decembrie 2023, a reparat masina, a plecat. Surpriza! pe 31 decembrie (sic) in timp ce spala vase, masina a inceput sa emita beep-uri. Din nou eroarea E 3100. Pe 31 decembrie. In noaptea de Anul Nou. Nici o luna nu trecuse de cand mi se reparase (sic, din nou) masina tot pentru E 3100. Am sunat la service, dar ce sa vezi? masina nu mai este in garantie, chiar daca la momentul achizitionarii mi s-a spus ca are 5 ani garantie, am inregistrat-o pe electrocasnice-bosch, dar pe site nu am gasit indrumare pentru a solicita garantia extinsa. Lipsea acest amanunt. In fine, astept sa fiu contactat de alt service pentru a stabili cand vine sa imi repare masina. Sper ca de data asta, reparatia sa tina mai mult de o luna.Nu va mai povestesc despre cuptorul cu microunde la care a aparut o eroare tot aproape de expirarea garantiei. Ha!

Comments (English): [ A newlywed couple's experience using a dishwasher ] || ---------------- || We're a newlywed couple. We're not planning on having kids, and both of us work. We looked into no-installation options, but the Power J model is incredibly meticulous. After two months of deliberation and research, even reading about the pros and cons on YouTube, we finally chose this product. Ultimately, we're extremely satisfied. Best of all, it didn't even require installation. All we had to do was pull the water line out to the sink. My husband used to get stressed out every time we moved into a new house and had a ton of dishes (he does the dishes in our house), but this is fantastic! Sentence (English): I was surprised by how big it was, bigger than I expected.
Comments (English): I was surprised by how big it was, bigger than I expected. The technician asked if I wanted it installed to open from the front or towards the sink. I asked how people usually install it, and he said that both are commonly done. He explained that since I need to pre-clean the items before putting them in, it would be better to have it open towards the sink. So, I had it installed to open towards the sink. He added that first-time installers usually have it open forward, while experienced users prefer to have it open towards the sink. Anyway, I think I made the right choice installing it that way. He also explained that for the pre-cleaning, I should remove food particles using only a scouring pad without detergent. I had always wondered, "If I'm going to pre-clean anyway, why bother having a dishwasher?" because I assumed that pre-cleaning itself required dish soap. But if I'm just scrubbing with a scouring pad without detergent, I figured it's worth doing. Also, I didn't listen at first and was curious what would happen if I ran it without pre-cleaning, so I just put a pot in. The burnt-on grime didn't come off. I realized that I have to scrub away stubborn stains with a scouring pad before putting them in. Since the drying mode is forcibly enabled in all modes, I turn it off every time I run the machine. It consumes a lot of electricity and takes a long time, so there is no real reason to rush the drying process. I used to grumble a bit when the pots weren't clean, but since I pre-wash everything and gather them to run whenever there's a pile of dishes (I'm the type who washes them immediately), I find it much easier. I hope to use this for a long time without any breakdowns. Here's a tip for those planning to buy dishwasher detergent before purchasing this product. I had bought liquid detergent, but looking at the pamphlet that came with it, it says that the Bespoke dishwasher requires the exclusive use of solid detergent. On the second day I used the liquid detergent I bought, it stopped with an error message full of foam because I hadn't used the dedicated detergent. So, I bought a very popular solid detergent and have been using it since. The cleaning power is better, and it works well without any errors.

Sentence (English): Because neither my family nor I like washing dishes, we decisively chose to install a dishwasher when renovating our new home.
Comments (English): Because neither my family nor I like washing dishes, we decisively chose to install a dishwasher when renovating our new home. After doing a lot of homework, we chose the Haier w5000 dishwasher. The water and electricity were reserved in advance during the water and electricity stage. When making cabinets, we installed it according to the washing requirements. The size of the bowl machine leaves enough space, and the flush-mounted installation makes it a perfect fit. It takes up no space and is beautiful. I really can’t help but praise it. The black panel is simple and elegant, with a hidden handle that won't knock your legs. The crystal touch screen comes with 12 washing programs and large icons, making it simple and easy to operate. The large capacity of 15 sets is super easy to load. Sentence (English): We've owned this dishwasher since February 2022.
Comments (English): [ Great dishwasher, with longevity concerns ] || ---------------- || We've owned this dishwasher since February 2022. Overall, I really like this dishwasher. I love the various features on it. I was a nursing mom at the time we bought it and having the steam cycle on it was tremendously helpful as I knew all the baby bottles and pump parts were getting sanitized properly without having to purchase an actual sterilizer. I loved how quiet it was, and the 3rd rack was great for all of the teeny tiny knick knacks that we needed to wash. I also liked having this connect to the ThinQ app, as getting the notifications on my phone that it was done washing dishes was very convenient on days that we had a lot of dishes. I also appreciated the reminders to run the tub clean cycle and clean out the filter at the bottom of the dishwasher, otherwise this maintenance item would have gone forgotten in our house. However, as the dishwasher has aged, we have experienced some issues with it. First, we did get the crack in the control panel, right through the middle of the power button. Fortunately, the dishwasher is still functioning fine, but the crack continues to get bigger and bigger and I worry that soon the power button will stop working.The older it gets, the louder it gets. When we first got it, I was truly shocked at how quiet the dishwasher was, and now it runs very noisily. It makes a sound almost like a dish is hitting a spray arm, however I ran a tub clean cycle with no dishes in the dishwasher and it made this same noise. It also makes a high pitched whistling noise, and a lower pitched whine. It unfortunately continues to get noisier the longer time goes on.Lastly, and most recently, we have discovered that dishes are no longer getting cleaned. I've tried a multitude of operations (normal, auto, heavy, pot and pans, high temp, dual zone, and every combination thereof) and dishes continue to not get clean. I have tried everything I can think of to get this resolved (cleaning the nozzles on the spray arms, running the tub clean cycle with an Affresh tablet, or the suggested vinegar bowl in the manual) to no avail. Even if I rinse the dishes clean, they are still coming out dirty (ie with an oily film on them). Very frustrating because I love every other part of this dishwasher! Fortunately, we did buy a protection plan through the third party we purchased this dishwasher from so they're working on getting it repaired, but the longevity of this dishwasher does not seem to be good at all. If you choose to purchase this dishwasher knowing the issues that it has, I would recommend also getting a protection plan on it, as you'll probably need to use it, even if you adhere to the manufacturer's maintenance suggestions put forth in the manual.

Sold home and hated to leave the dishwasher but that is what you do. Have just purchased another 800 series as the model previous was no longer offered. This was the closest. Love the crystal dry, seeing how the softener goes (bought 19 pounds online and not too bad of price). Held about 5 cups on first filling. Was easy to fill. The star off is ONLY for the lack of installation by Costco as was stated on website as a marketing/sales option included. They never contacted us to install. We just did it ourselves. Was not too hard if you have ability to read/follow directions along with mechanical abilities and of course the right tools. Did not like making such a large hole in the side of under sink cabinet for the water line input but was able to neaten up mess from previous owners' installation. Yes, making lemonade from lemons but it did work. Gets dishes clean even when lots of creative loading/dishes/plastics/cups and pans were in the cycle. Still can load a lot of dishes with flexibility of racks and 3rd rack. Able to turn off rinse aid which is good and different from my first model. Now I don't have the taste (even from 'natural' rinse aids) or additional whatever to ingest which is not food. Trying to be better about this without going nuts. Options help me choose what is right for my family.

Sentence (English): The dishwasher is great for the price.
Comments (English): [ Very solid dishwasher ] || ---------------- || The dishwasher is great for the price. I purchased the dishwasher for $598 before taxes, and it is a big step up from the outgoing 8-year old dishwasher. I have been using the dishwasher for about 2 weeks, and all the dishes have come out spotless, and most dishes are very dry. The only dishes with any significant water on them are items with a rim that trap water, so that is expected. I like the filter, it is easy to remove and clean. The third rack is a new feature for me, and it is great for kids' cup lids, bottle nipples, and other shallow items. The bottle jets really get the baby bottles clean. I am not sure how much I will use them after finishing bottle feeding, but you can turn the jets off for the cycle if your load of dishes doesn't need them. I also really like the silverware jets, and haven't had any issue with dirty silverware. The adjustable middle rack can be set in a low or high position. The high position gives more space for the bottom rack and still leaves enough room for pretty tall cups. The racks feel pretty solid and roll nicely. My biggest annoyance is the track for the bottom rack does not line up with the door, so it is a bit bumpy to pull out the bottom rack. Be aware that cycle times are pretty long, but it isn't an issue if running it over night. Our normal setting is Auto sense with steam, normal dry, and bottle jets on. The cycle takes 4 hours and 6 minutes. I think the drying/steam is about the last hour of the cycle. I did run a shorter cycle in the middle of the day that took about 2.5 hours, and it still got the dishes very clean.

I purchased the dishwasher for $598 before taxes, and it is a big step up from the outgoing 8-year old dishwasher. I have been using the dishwasher for about 2 weeks, and all the dishes have come out spotless, and most dishes are very dry. The only dishes with any significant water on them are items with a rim that trap water, so that is expected. I like the filter, it is easy to remove and clean. I am not sure how much I will use them after finishing bottle feeding, but you can turn the jets off for the cycle if your load of dishes doesn't need them. I also really like the silverware jets, and haven't had any issue with dirty silverware. The adjustable middle rack can be set in a low or high position. My biggest annoyance is the track for the bottom rack does not line up with the door, so it is a bit bumpy to pull out the bottom rack. Be aware that cycle times are pretty long, but it isn't an issue if running it over night. Our normal setting is Auto sense with steam, normal dry, and bottle jets on. The cycle takes 4 hours and 6 minutes. I think the drying/steam is about the last hour of the cycle. I did run a shorter cycle in the middle of the day that took about 2.5 hours, and it still got the dishes very clean.

He also said almost anything I would want to know about Bosch dishwashers are also on line (which I found to be true). I ordered an 800 Series and chose one that would look good with my other appliances. It was delivered soon and installed. I think I made the right choice. This dishwasher makes no sounds, cleans great, even on a 1 hour cycle. The only slight negative is that some tops of cups and plastics need to be blotted with a towel to get the wet off (sort of like my old Kitchenaid). But even so, I would recommend it.

Sentence (English): 11 years ago I purchased the Bosch dishwasher model that was extra high quality and still made in Germany thinking it would last as long as my previous Maytags had.
Comments (English): [ Don't Make em Like They Used To ] || ---------------- || 11 years ago I purchased the Bosch dishwasher model that was extra high quality and still made in Germany thinking it would last as long as my previous Maytags had.But sadly, 11 years after purchase, the Bosch required a repair nearly the price of a new dishwasher. NO way it should have died that young when I still have a 20 yr old Maytag going strong in our rental property. But manufacturers REFUSE to use the technology we have known for ages to make appliances last a long time. In other words, they aren't truly interested in saving the planet but prefer to manufacture twice as often as necessary while also sending scads of dead appliances to recycling and landfills when they could simply still be running strong in our kitchens. I had thought maybe Bosch was a holdout for the environment and quality, but no.Anyway, I had always been pleased with the cleaning of the older Bosch, so I didn't shop around much before purchasing the 800 series. To be honest, nothing else was going to be any higher quality, and Bosch still does hold a lot more dishes than the other machines even though their space measures smaller. Ugg. I could immediately see cut corners. The machine is noticeably lighter weight than the old one. The door feels flimsy and almost flexible. The bottom toe stop area is now made of a floppy black piece of vinyl that hangs down and is visible from far away. Even though the decibel rating is lower than my old one, the new one is definitely louder. That doesn't surprise me considering there is less insulation around the case. The new rack layout does not work quite as well. I have been trying different arrangements which have helped, but there is still this odd amount of wasted space on one side of it that I just don't understand. Even with the Crystal Dry, the dishes do end up wetter than the previous model, which was also a bit wet at the end. The buttons are now hidden when the door is closed, but that's not so unique. The annoying thing is that the timer is now hidden so you can't glance at it and know how much time is left. You have to wash your soiled kitchen hands, get out your phone, and signal around the world to see how much time is left on your cycle that could be seen right there beside you. And finally, the requirement to use a phone app to run my dishwasher is just baffling. I cannot figure out the motivation behind limiting some of the features to the app. When would I EVER need to get out my phone to run my dishwasher? So all in all, lots of disappointments, but it does wash well if you run it on the heavy cycle, and it still may be your best bet in a world where we love to create poor quality appliances just to keep us buying.

Sentence (English): This is my first time using a dishwasher.
Comments (English): This is my first time using a dishwasher. I was considering a domestic brand, but I bought it because the price was so good and it had an auto-open feature. The technician called 10 minutes early and arrived. He removed the sink and put the dishwasher in. He took the sink with him. Since only the dishwasher was delivered, there was no detergent, so I just ran it for the first time. They say Frosh is the best, but since it was my first time, I just bought 100 10g packets of Exploration Dishwasher Detergent. I put a pot of rice cake and dumpling soup in it and it washed cleanly. The photo shows the dishwasher right after it was finished washing. I only used one 10g packet. If there's a lot of oil or dishes, I'll try two. After the auto-open feature, the water dries out if you leave it alone, but some items still have a little moisture left. It's not inconvenient. It's about the amount of moisture left on an overturned dish after washing it. I saw this online, but if there's moisture inside the container where the detergent is sprayed out, the plastic outer packaging of the detergent tablet melts and sticks to it, so when the case lid is opened, it doesn't come out and remains inside. Be sure to wipe off any moisture before using. I was debating on a dishwasher for several years and bought Media, and I'm very satisfied.
Comments (Original): 식기세척기 처음 사용해요. 국내 브랜드 사려다가 미디어 가격대가 너무 좋고 자동오픈기능 있다고 해서 구매했습니다.기사님 10분 전에 전화하고 오시구요. 싱크대 빼내고 식세기 넣어줬어요. 빼낸 싱크대는 가져가셨습니다.기계만 오기 때문에 세제가 없어서 첫 가동은 그냥 해봤구요. 세제는 프로쉬가 최고라는데 처음이니까 그냥 탐사 식기세척기 세제 10g 100개분 샀어요.떡만두국 끓여먹은 냄비넣고 돌렸는데 깨끗하게 잘 씻겨졌어요.사진은 세척 완료 후 오픈 되자마자 열어 본 거구오. 세제는 10g 1개만 써봤어요. 기름기 많거나 그릇양 많으면 2개 써보려구요. 자동오픈 되고나서 냅두면 물기 마르긴 하는데 어떤 거는 물기 살짝 남아있고 그래요. 불편할 정도는 아니예요. 설거지해서 엎어 놓은 그릇에 물기 남은 그 정도예요.인터넷에서 본건데 세제 튕겨나가는 통 안에 물기가 있으면 타블렛 세제 겉비닐이 안에서 녹아 붙어버려 케이스 뚜껑이 열려도 사출되지 않고 안에 남기도 한데요. 사용하기 전에 물기를 잘 닦아주세요.식세기 몇년 고민하다 미디어로 산건데 전 만족스러워요.

The technician called 10 minutes early and arrived. He removed the sink and put the dishwasher in. He took the sink with him. Since only the dishwasher was delivered, there was no detergent, so I just ran it for the first time. They say Frosh is the best, but since it was my first time, I just bought 100 10g packets of Exploration Dishwasher Detergent. I put a pot of rice cake and dumpling soup in it and it washed cleanly. The photo shows the dishwasher right after it was finished washing. I only used one 10g packet. If there's a lot of oil or dishes, I'll try two. After the auto-open feature, the water dries out if you leave it alone, but some items still have a little moisture left. It's not inconvenient. It's about the amount of moisture left on an overturned dish after washing it. I saw this online, but if there's moisture inside the container where the detergent is sprayed out, the plastic outer packaging of the detergent tablet melts and sticks to it, so when the case lid is opened, it doesn't come out and remains inside. Be sure to wipe off any moisture before using. I was debating on a dishwasher for several years and bought Media, and I'm very satisfied.
Comments (Original): 식기세척기 처음 사용해요. 국내 브랜드 사려다가 미디어 가격대가 너무 좋고 자동오픈기능 있다고 해서 구매했습니다.기사님 10분 전에 전화하고 오시구요. 싱크대 빼내고 식세기 넣어줬어요. 빼낸 싱크대는 가져가셨습니다.기계만 오기 때문에 세제가 없어서 첫 가동은 그냥 해봤구요. 세제는 프로쉬가 최고라는데 처음이니까 그냥 탐사 식기세척기 세제 10g 100개분 샀어요.떡만두국 끓여먹은 냄비넣고 돌렸는데 깨끗하게 잘 씻겨졌어요.사진은 세척 완료 후 오픈 되자마자 열어 본 거구오. 세제는 10g 1개만 써봤어요. 기름기 많거나 그릇양 많으면 2개 써보려구요. 자동오픈 되고나서 냅두면 물기 마르긴 하는데 어떤 거는 물기 살짝 남아있고 그래요. 불편할 정도는 아니예요. 설거지해서 엎어 놓은 그릇에 물기 남은 그 정도예요.인터넷에서 본건데 세제 튕겨나가는 통 안에 물기가 있으면 타블렛 세제 겉비닐이 안에서 녹아 붙어버려 케이스 뚜껑이 열려도 사출되지 않고 안에 남기도 한데요. 사용하기 전에 물기를 잘 닦아주세요.식세기 몇년 고민하다 미디어로 산건데 전 만족스러워요.

Comments (English): [ If you want to drastically reduce your housework time, you absolutely must buy this! ] || ---------------- || Review written on January 1, 2024. Added a negative review on January 9, 2024. This is my honest review after using it for about three months! ~~Honest review of the pros~~. Appearance. It's beautiful! My kitchen is entirely white, and I think the beige color goes well with it! Beige itself goes well with any color, so it's a nice, versatile color. Convenience. It holds a lot of dishes! This time, I tried to put in as many dishes as I could and washed them to take pictures. I took the pictures, and they washed cleanly without any problems. It holds a lot of dishes! (See pictures). There are three of us, including my son, and we use a lot of cups. Even after breakfast, lunch, and dinner, and running the dishwasher, there was still room! I think it's more than enough for a family of four! Functionality. It's so versatile, I love it! We only use the basics, but it also has a high-temperature sterilization function, so I can use it with confidence. My favorite feature is the automatic opening function after washing! With the last one, I had to open it manually after washing. This thing dries automatically and even opens. If I turn it on before bed, I can easily take it out and use it the next day. I think it's really great! ~~Honestly, the only downside~~ is the time. Everything is great, but the downside is that it takes too long. Even with just the basic cycle, it takes 2 hours and 30 minutes. I added the basic cycle, a double rinse, and a sterilization cycle, so it took 3 hours. Three hours isn't a problem, but I remember being surprised at first, thinking, "3 hours?" But I turn it on before bed, so it's not really a problem. I was a little surprised that the regular cycle took three times as long, compared to just one hour. That's why I think it's a more reliable product! When I press the button. This is added on January 9, 2024! When I set it up and press start, it makes a sound. It just makes a sound, but there's no light or anything. Sometimes I wonder if I pressed it. I have to close the door and check to see if the washer starts or not. So, sometimes the door closes and then opens right away (like when one button isn't inserted). Sometimes, when I open and close it, it doesn't work. Sometimes, it works, but if there was a sign that it works when I close it, it would be perfect. This part is a bit disappointing! It's not so much that I'm worried about it when I actually use it, but sometimes, when I wonder if I've pressed it, there's no way to check. That's disappointing! Other than these two, there are no downsides! This product is excellent! ~~Overall impressions~~. The beige color goes well with a white kitchen. This dishwasher has excellent cleaning capabilities! If you struggle with dishwashing, try it! You won't regret it! ~~~~~~~~. I hope my review was helpful to someone! Enjoy your shopping! Thank you for reading!

Sentence (English): This is my first time using a dishwasher.
Comments (English): This is my first time using a dishwasher. I was considering a domestic brand, but I bought it because the price was so good and it had an auto-open feature. The technician called 10 minutes early and arrived. He removed the sink and put the dishwasher in. He took the sink away. Since only the dishwasher was delivered, there was no detergent, so I just ran it for the first time. I heard Frosh is the best, but since it was my first time, I just bought 100 10g packets of Exploration Dishwasher Detergent. I put in a pot of rice cake and dumpling soup and it washed everything cleanly. The photo is of me opening the container right after the dishwasher was finished. I only used one 10g packet. I'll try two packets if there's a lot of grease or dishes. After the auto-open feature, the water dries out if you leave it alone, but some dishes still have a little moisture left. It's not inconvenient. It's like the water left on an upside-down dish after washing. Since only the dishwasher was delivered, there was no detergent, so I just ran it for the first time. I heard Frosh is the best, but since it was my first time, I just bought 100 10g packets of Exploration Dishwasher Detergent. I put in a pot of rice cake and dumpling soup and it washed everything cleanly. The photo is of me opening the container right after the dishwasher was finished. I only used one 10g packet. I'll try two packets if there's a lot of grease or dishes. After the auto-open feature, the water dries out if you leave it alone, but some dishes still have a little moisture left. It's not inconvenient. It's like the water left on an upside-down dish after washing. I saw this online: If there's moisture inside the dispenser, the plastic wrap on the tablet will melt and stick to it, preventing it from being dispensed when the case lid is opened and leaving residue inside. Be sure to wipe off any moisture before use. I've been debating on a dishwasher for years, but I'm completely satisfied with this one.
Comments (Original): 식기세척기 처음 사용해요. 국내 브랜드 사려다가 미디어 가격대가 너무 좋고 자동오픈기능 있다고 해서 구매했습니다.기사님 10분 전에 전화하고 오시구요. 싱크대 빼내고 식세기 넣어줬어요. 빼낸 싱크대는 가져가셨습니다.기계만 오기 때문에 세제가 없어서 첫 가동은 그냥 해봤구요. 세제는 프로쉬가 최고라는데 처음이니까 그냥 탐사 식기세척기 세제 10g 100개분 샀어요.떡만두국 끓여먹은 냄비넣고 돌렸는데 깨끗하게 잘 씻겨졌어요.사진은 세척 완료 후 오픈 되자마자 열어 본 거구오. 세제는 10g 1개만 써봤어요. 기름기 많거나 그릇양 많으면 2개 써보려구요. 자동오픈 되고나서 냅두면 물기 마르긴 하는데 어떤 거는 물기 살짝 남아있고 그래요. 불편할 정도는 아니예요. 설거지해서 엎어 놓은 그릇에 물기 남은 그 정도예요.인터넷에서 본건데 세제 튕겨나가는 통 안에 물기가 있으면 타블렛 세제 겉비닐이 안에서 녹아 붙어버려 케이스 뚜껑이 열려도 사출되지 않고 안에 남기도 한데요. 사용하기 전에 물기를 잘 닦아주세요.식세기 몇년 고민하다 미디어로 산건데 전 만족스러워요.
